name: The Washington Post editorial board
lean_basis: AllSides rates the Post's news Lean Left. In Oct 2024 the paper ended presidential endorsements only; it continued endorsing in Senate, House and Maryland races that fall. Its 2026 DC general-election editorials are paywalled and were not opened this run.

name: Washington City Paper
lean_basis: Alt-weekly with a progressive editorial voice; publishes DC election coverage and, in some cycles, endorsements. No 2026 general-election endorsement page was found this run.

name: Hill Rag / East of the River (Capital Community News)
lean_basis: Neighborhood monthlies covering Capitol Hill and east of the river. Publish detailed candidate roundups and explainers (the Oct 12 and Oct 13, 2026 pieces are the clearest guides to the at-large count and the full ballot) but do not endorse.

name: League of Women Voters of the District of Columbia (VOTE411)
lean_basis: Nonpartisan civic organization. Does not endorse candidates. Supported Initiative 83 (RCV and open primaries) in 2024. VOTE411 lists DC's registration deadlines; no 2026 DC candidate questionnaire was found this run.

name: DC Democratic State Committee
lean_basis: Official party organization. Its nominees are the June primary winners. The committee opposed Initiative 83 in 2024 and sued to block it.

name: DC Republican Party
lean_basis: Official party organization. Chair Patrick Mara announced on June 18, 2026 'the largest candidate slate in decades': nominees in every districtwide race except mayor.

name: DC Statehood Green Party
lean_basis: Official party organization; DC affiliate of the Green Party. Fielded nominees for mayor, delegate, at-large and Wards 1 and 5 in 2026. Its chair, Darryl Moch, is its at-large nominee.

name: DC for Democracy
lean_basis: Self-described progressive grassroots organization; endorses by member vote. Its 2026 page covers only the June Democratic primary.

name: Greater Greater Washington (GGWash) Elections Committee
lean_basis: Urbanist nonprofit focused on housing, transit and land use. Its volunteer Elections Committee endorses in DC races; the newsroom does not. Published one general-election endorsement (at-large) on Oct 1, 2026 and says more may follow.

name: Metro DC Democratic Socialists of America
lean_basis: Self-described democratic socialist organization. Endorsed Janeese Lewis George (mayor) and Aparna Raj (Ward 1) in the June primary; both are its members. Its 2026 page lists no general-election candidate endorsements.

name: DC Chamber of Commerce
lean_basis: Business association. No 2026 endorsement page was found this run.

name: DC Police Union (FOP Metropolitan Police Department Labor Committee)
lean_basis: Police labor union; has endorsed in DC mayor, Council and AG races and has clashed publicly with progressive councilmembers over public-safety legislation. No 2026 general-election endorsement was found this run.

name: Metropolitan Washington Council, AFL-CIO
lean_basis: Regional labor federation. Announced 2026 DC endorsements on March 26, 2026 (primary cycle); its voter guide page lists 'No Recommendation' for the Democratic at-large primary and shows other picks only as images.

name: Sierra Club, DC Chapter
lean_basis: Environmental advocacy organization. Its endorsements page carries a '2026 General Election Endorsements' heading listing mayor, AG, at-large and ward Council picks.
